headline: Prime-uniform divided powers and tensor orbits
claimBoundary: The reported counterexamples are external prior work. This page separately labels Lean-checked theorems, exact finite computations, mathematical candidates, refuted formulations, and unresolved steps.

lean.fullBuild: green on the PR 13 formalization head

claims.name: Two counterexamples to the broad ICC property-(T) rigidity conjecture were reported
claims.evidence: Independent constructions were reported in 2026. Their operator-algebraic conclusions are prior art and are not reproved by this repository.

claims.name: Canonical group-algebra bialgebra structure reconstructs the group
claims.evidence: The full pinned Lean graph checks the restriction to group-like elements and the induced group isomorphism. The statement assumes preservation of the canonical coproduct.

claims.name: A nonzero first-two-symmetric rank-three polynomial tensor has infinite elementary orbit
claims.evidence: Lean checks an explicit elementary-transvection tail with infinite range over every field. The arbitrary-rank generalization is not included in this status.

claims.name: The shifted ternary carry extension has exponent dividing nine
claims.evidence: The checked cocycle chain proves the multiplication-by-three identity, exponent bound, three-torsion characterization, and shifted-kernel cardinality 3^(3n).

claims.name: Interior prime binomial coefficients and ternary spectral diagonals cancel
claims.evidence: Lean checks that p choose j vanishes in F_p for 0<j<p. It also checks the explicit ternary e_1 and e_2 diagonal-coefficient cancellations and the e_3 simultaneous shift. This is the arithmetic core of the spectral quotient, not the full module decomposition.

claims.name: Selected prime, rank, degree, Witt, and spectral-resolution cases reproduce exactly
claims.evidence: Twelve deterministic certificate suites pass on their declared bounded or symbolic domains. The spectral suite reproduces the complete Betti polynomials for p=2,3,5,7. No conclusion is extended beyond those domains by computation alone.

claims.name: Spectral Frobenius-kernel decomposition and prime-uniform free resolution
claims.evidence: A written orbit-block proof decomposes the divided power over the symmetric spectral ring and concentrates all nonfreeness in r copies of (e_1,...,e_(p-1)). It predicts projective dimension p-2 for p>=3, identifies the nonfree locus with the Frobenius small diagonal, and explains the ternary numerator 7+11q+11q^2-2q^3 by three degree-three syzygies. The arithmetic core is Lean checked and the Betti identities are replayed, but the module theorem is not yet Lean checked or independently reviewed.

claims.name: Stable and odd-critical divided-power cyclicity
claims.evidence: A written induction and selected exact certificates support the claim. The general theorem is not yet formalized or independently reviewed.

claims.name: General stable and critical polynomial-tensor orbit theorem
claims.evidence: A written coordinate-block argument extends the checked rank-three pattern. Only the rank-three critical case is presently Lean checked.

claims.name: An untwisted linear cubic retraction works over every characteristic-three field
claims.evidence: The checked scalar obstruction shows that such a map forces x^3=x for every scalar. A general formulation needs a Frobenius twist.

claims.name: A completed prime-uniform property-(T) counterexample family
claims.evidence: The synthesis still depends on unformalized group-theoretic and operator-algebraic interfaces, specialist comparison with prior work, and independent review.
